+"""Directed soft-assignment matching with a source entropy floor."""

+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Match source assignments to detached target assignments, row-wise."""
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.1)
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    gamma = parameters.get("gamma", 1.0)
+    h_min = parameters.get("h_min", 0.5)
+    weight = parameters.get("lambda", 0.001)
+
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook, p=2).square() / tau
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook, p=2).square() / tau
+    p_source = F.softmax(source_logits, dim=-1)
+    q_target = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=-1).detach()
+    directed_kl = (q_target * ((q_target + eps).log() - (p_source + eps).log())).sum(-1)
+    entropy = -(p_source * (p_source + eps).log()).sum(-1)
+    barrier = gamma * F.relu(h_min - entropy).square()
+    row_loss = directed_kl + barrier
+    mask = mask.to(device=row_loss.device, dtype=row_loss.dtype)
+    valid_count = mask.sum()
+    mean_valid = (row_loss * mask).sum() / valid_count.clamp_min(1.0)
+    return weight * torch.where(valid_count > 0, mean_valid, row_loss.sum() * 0.0)

+"""Directed soft-assignment matching with a source entropy floor."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F

+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Match source assignments to detached target assignments, row-wise."""
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.1)
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    gamma = parameters.get("gamma", 1.0)
+    h_min = parameters.get("h_min", 0.5)
+    weight = parameters.get("lambda", 0.001)
+
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook, p=2).square() / tau
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook, p=2).square() / tau
+    p_source = F.softmax(source_logits, dim=-1)
+    q_target = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=-1).detach()
+    directed_kl = (q_target * ((q_target + eps).log() - (p_source + eps).log())).sum(-1)
+    entropy = -(p_source * (p_source + eps).log()).sum(-1)
+    barrier = gamma * F.relu(h_min - entropy).square()
+    row_loss = directed_kl + barrier
+    mask = mask.to(device=row_loss.device, dtype=row_loss.dtype)
